question: On 14 February 2022, ISRO successful launched its first earth observation satellite of 2022, EOS-04. It was launched by which rocket?
solution:
The correct answer is __**PSLV-C52.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Polar Satellite Launch Vehicle (PSLV)** is a launch vehicle developed by the **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** to launch** satellites** into orbit.
 
• **PSLV-C52** was used to launch **EOS-04,** which is an** earth observation satellite.**
 
• It is designed to provide images of the **earth's surface and atmosphere** for applications such as **agriculture, forestry, water management,** and **disaster management.**
 
• PSLV-C51, launched on February 28, 2021, carried **Brazil's Amazonia-1 satellite **as its primary payload, along with 18 other co-passenger satellites.
 
• PSLV-C53, launched on April 28, 2021, carried** 14 satellites, **including India's primary payload, the **EMISAT satellite.**
 
• PSLV-C54, launched on August 12, 2021, carried India's **Earth observation satellite, EOS-03, **along with three other co-passenger satellites.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The PSLV has been used for a variety of missions, including launching** remote sensing satellites, navigation satellites, and communication satellites.**
 
• The PSLV has been in service since **1993 **and has a success rate of **96.6%.**
 
• ISRO has also developed the **Geosynchronous Satellite Launch Vehicle** (GSLV) for launching** heavier satellites** into** geostationary orbit.**
 
• ISRO is one of the world's leading space agencies and has successfully launched numerous missions, including the **Chandrayaan-1** and **Mangalyaan missions** to the **moon and Mars**, respectively.
